mirror_rule.part_placement: Mirror the assembled rig, or mirror every part and all its anchors in the same 512px canvas. Hand-local coordinates use width 256.
mirror_rule.retain_scene_ground: When keeping the world origin at [256,444], translate the complete mirrored assembly +1px in X.
mirror_rule.anatomical_sides: Reflection exchanges anatomical left/right. For mirrored directions, target left uses the mirrored source right sprite/anchor and target right uses mirrored source left. Preserve the character gameplay hand assignment when carrying items.

skin_mask.encoding: R=base skin coverage, G=skin shadow coverage; B=0; alpha=255 on skin, 0 elsewhere. Data mask, not display art.
skin_mask.usage: Tint only masked pixels. Use the same base and shadow skin colours for head, torso neck, hands, and procedural arms. Sample as linear data with point filtering.

headwear_fit.placement: Helmet canvas aligns with head canvas at zero offset; helmet and head share the directional head_mount and the same parent animation.
headwear_fit.draw_order: Render helmet after head, before final assembled outline. Torso remains under head.
headwear_fit.hair: These overlays are fitted over the included blond hair. No automatic hair removal is needed for this set. Fit future head hairstyles to the same skull envelope and check hair protrusion.

assembly: Add-on heads. Existing torso owns neck; head mounts and shared canvas origins are unchanged. Head follows existing animation head parent; helmet overlays follow the same parent.
